releaseNotes:
Release v0.19.0

New Features:
- Search your solution by pressing Shift twice: find file names and paths, node labels and types, aliases, parameter values, expressions, and scripts. Jump directly to a file or node, including unsaved edits in the current graph (PS-240).
- Webhook triggers across workflows can share a port using different paths, while retaining their own authentication, body limits, and response settings (PS-238).
- Queue trigger events until the previous workflow finishes, including all branches. Interval and webhook triggers offer an optional Queue Events setting; File System Watcher queues events automatically.

Improvements:
- Update Rust dependencies, both desktop frontends to Vite 8.3.4, and Functions to Google APIs 183 (PS-245).
- Upgrade HMAC and SHA-256 together, preserving existing signature behavior (PS-241).
- Refresh Functions lint tooling and update the solution search, trigger queueing, and Docker webhook guides (PS-189).

Behavior Changes:
- File System Watcher executions now run sequentially instead of overlapping.
- Webhook paths match literally. Paths containing braces, such as /hooks/{id}, are rejected; use distinct literal paths instead (PS-238).
- Queued webhook response timeouts include the time spent waiting in the queue. An HTTP timeout does not cancel the queued workflow.
